title: Restricted-Days Credit on the Pocketwire Personal Account Monthly Plan Fee
content:
### The rule

The restricted-days credit on the renewal plan fee of a Pocketwire Personal Account on monthly billing is worked out on the fee after the renewal discount percentage, over the ending billing period, which runs from the date of the previous plan fee entry to the handling date (the renewal date itself when the fee is booked on time) and whose length is the calendar days between those two dates.

The credit follows the account's most recent restriction, as recorded on the account (its reason, the date it was placed and the date it was recovered or lifted):

1. **Security lock for suspected account takeover, recovered on or after the start of the ending period — pro rata.** The credit is the discounted fee times the days from the later of the lock date and the period start to the recovered date, divided by the period's length.
2. **Limitation for risk review or for identity documents required, lifted on or after the start of the ending period — all or nothing.** The credit is the whole discounted fee when the days from the later of the limitation date and the period start to the lifted date are more than half the period's length, and nothing when they are not.
3. **Any other case — no credit.**

Days between two dates are counted as calendar days from the earlier date to the later one, the earlier date itself not counted; the same date on both sides gives 0 days.

### Worked cases (hypothetical dates and fee)

Previous plan fee entry dated 10 March, handling date 10 April: the ending period is 31 days. Discounted fee 9.00.

| Most recent restriction | Days counted | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Lock for suspected account takeover placed 20 March, recovered 30 March | 10 | 9.00 times 10 divided by 31, which is 2.9032… |
| Lock for suspected account takeover placed 1 March, recovered 14 March | From 10 March (the later date) to 14 March: 4 | 9.00 times 4 divided by 31, which is 1.1612… |
| Limitation for risk review placed 1 March, lifted 28 March | From 10 March to 28 March: 18, more than half of 31 | 9.00, the whole discounted fee |
| Limitation for identity documents required placed 12 March, lifted 27 March | 15, not more than half of 31 | Nothing |
| Lock for suspected account takeover recovered 5 March | Recovered before the period start | No credit |

In a 30-day ending period, a limitation that covers exactly 15 days is not more than half the period's length, so it earns nothing; 16 days earn the whole discounted fee.
